claims.claim: Current public sources illustrate scope, access, copy and provider distinctions; they do not establish ValeGrid policy at the fictional cutoff.
Primary content and routine replicas are EU; identity and telemetry are global or US; a historical support attachment is US and overseas rendering is recorded with limited detail.
Export preparation and connector disablement have bounded consent; labor and continuation offer are approved; migration, deletion and amendments have separate requirements.
Production move cannot meet the September 17 review, has testing and outage dependencies, and cannot regionalize global identity or old vendor artifacts.
Current fee paid, next annual invoice unissued and uncollected, extension not active, no renewal purchase needed for approved work.
Broad assurance and signed matrix support customer reliance; content examples and retained DPA support narrower scope. Letter terminology may imply a warranty beyond a factual content statement.
